description:
Cast Eternal Scourge either from your hand or from exile by paying {2}.
When Eternal Scourge enters the battlefield, Marauding Raptor triggers, dealing 2 damage to Eternal Scourge.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Eternal Scourge, adding {C}{C}.
When Eternal Scourge dies, Unscythe triggers, exiling Eternal Scourge and creating a 2/2 Zombie creature token.
When the Zombie enters the battlefield, Marauding Raptor triggers.
Holding priority, activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Zombie, adding {C}{C}.
When the Zombie dies, Unscythe triggers, failing to exile the Zombie as it no longer exists.
Resolve the Marauding Raptor trigger, doing nothing as the Zombie is no longer on the battlefield.
Repeat.
